description: Run proof verification and return a zip with screenshots, network call counts, response times and logs.

allow.description: Comma-separated regexes allowed in noErrors check.

branch.description: Branch to verify in an isolated worktree.

devices.description: Comma-separated device names, e.g. "iPhone SE,iPhone 16 Pro Max".

keep.description: Leave sessions running after the proof.

route.description: Deep link or URL to open on each device before capture.

settleMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after navigation before screenshot (default 2000).

name: run_proof
